results.name: Task checklist supports creation, edit, completion, removal and reload
Task estimates and elapsed tracking persist across reload and stop on completion
Repeating task completes once and creates a clean next occurrence
Future reminders save and use the configured lead time
Reference photos remain local and AI defaults to hints without photos
Task templates save a checklist and create independent tasks without photos or answers
Templates allow editing, independent creation and deletion
Exam planner distributes topic tasks before the exam and calendar opens sessions
Weekly progress counts new completion dates by subject
Command palette searches details, lists and links and supports keyboard opening
Website capture creates Inbox task with selection and source using the actual capture handler
Desktop notification scheduler delivers once and reschedules after edits
Failed desktop delivery keeps its reminder pending and backs off instead of looping
Pins support logos, names, no glass, direct removal and undo
Renaming and deleting a subject preserves its templates and plans through undo
Backups preserve checklists, plans, templates, dates and time without connection secrets
New views and task details remain contained on narrow screens
